The executed results of the KR-ZERO-ALGEBRA-2026-09 experiment (4,203 element cases; 1,395/1,223/1,182/1,189-case sub-populations across different property tests): 9 of 11 algebraic hypotheses REFUTED (L^2=L idempotence; L_A L_B=L_B L_A commutativity; individual-Zero-implies-group-Zero H5; group-Zero-implies-individual-Zero H6; reference-independence H7; contract-independence H8, 495 differences; invariant=Zero H9; Remainder=D-Eliminated as the sole construction H10; RuleEliminable=CounterfactualZero H11, only 55.75% agreement with an asymmetric over-elimination bias of 1,559 false removals vs 301 missed removals); 2 CONFIRMED (H3 termination, H4 monotone decrease); two minimal witnesses generalize element-wise Zero to subset-level Zero_{T,Pi}(S;D): a redundancy witness D=[x,x] where each x is individually Zero but the pair is not (131 witnesses), and a cancellation witness D=[+c,-c] where neither element is individually Zero but the pair is (63 witnesses); the elimination process is a terminating, non-confluent rewriting system (169/1,189 divergences between simultaneous/forward/reverse processing, traced to one concrete mechanism: removing a token causes two other tokens to become adjacent, activating a context-dependent transformation); a boundary-preservation result finds 196 of 1,223 otherwise-tempting eliminations (16.03%) blocked once provenance/uncertainty/scope/contradiction-state enter the contract; and H10's three candidate Remainder constructions show D-Eliminated and contract-unresolved-material coincide exactly in all 1,182 tested cases while transformation-residual differs, establishing Remainder is transformation-relative, not simple set subtraction.

A structural abstraction of Vedic Mathematics computational sutras (Bharati Krishna Tirtha's book) into a candidate information-transformation algebra: the 'base and deviation' multiplication method (e.g. 95x92 via deviations from 100) is generalized to Object=Reference+Deviation and a typed Represent(D|K0)=(K0,Delta_{K0}(D),R_{K0}(D)) where the base K0 need not be numeric (textual/ontological/temporal/inquiry-relative/organizational); 'Vertically and Crosswise' multiplication is generalized to a relational-interaction operation Cross(X,Y); 'Last Totalling 10' is generalized to Detect-Constraint-then-Select-Transformation (feeding Method Selection); 'Alternative Elimination and Retention' maps almost directly onto D->(E,R) with E={x: Zero_{T,Pi}(x)}; 'The Remainder Remains Constant' motivates testing R(T1(D))=?=R(T2(D)) as a route to discovering information invariants; 'By Mere Observation' motivates an Observe:D->Pattern step preceding Method Selection; the book's verification/checking methods motivate a distinct Verify(T(D),D)->Pass/Fail/Undetermined operation. Proposes a Candidate Transformation Algebra with carrier K=(B,Delta,I,R,Gamma) and nine candidate operations (Observe,Base,Diff,Cross,Transform,Eliminate,Retain,Verify,Compose), with algebraic properties (identity, composition, associativity, idempotence, commutativity, conservation, remainder stability, Zero compositionality) explicitly left as future experiments rather than assumed, and a proposed new research lane 'EXP -- Vedic-Inspired Information Transformation Algebra' implementing five base operations (Base,Diff,Cross,Eliminate,Remainder) on a small corpus before asking what algebraic structure they form.

A disciplined philosophical-interpretation study run alongside KR-ZERO-ALGEBRA-2026-09, restricted by Theory v1.2's ban on Gita-concept->primitive->architecture promotion to producing only questions/lenses/corroborations. Finds three genuine corroborations against the executed KR-ZERO-ALGEBRA results (all classified [EXT]/lens, never adopted): (C-1) Gita 18.2's distinction between renouncing an action (sannyasa) versus renouncing its fruit (tyaga) corroborates the experiment's finding that two of three candidate Remainder constructions coincide exactly (A=C, 1182/1182 cases) while the third (transformation residual) differs -- 'the residue of the operation is not the residue of the concern'; (C-2) 18.48's injunction not to abandon flawed-but-native work corroborates the 16.03% boundary-preservation finding (196/1,223 blocked eliminations); (C-3), called the strongest, is that the Gita's three-way classification of tyaga by its GROUND (tamasa/rajasa/sattvika) rather than its outcome corroborates the experiment's PATH-A-vs-PATH-B finding (55.75% agreement, markedly asymmetric: 1,559 over-removed vs 301 under-removed) -- 'an elimination is not adequately characterised by what it removes; it is characterised by the ground on which it removes it.' Explicitly finds NO textual support for the algebraic results (H5/H6 group-non-compositionality, non-confluence, termination, H9 invariant!=Zero) and refuses to name any kernel candidate, citing the experiment's own final-status rule and its own prior four-in-a-row record of yielding no kernel entities from Gita material.

An information-theoretic reformulation of the same 'digit reduction' research question, reviewing a submitted proof: adequacy is defined as H(Q(D)|T(D))=0 (a.s. fiber preservation), with the submitted admissibility Definition 1.4 found NOT to imply the necessity Condition 3 (conditioning on a valid region 0.9-probable does not force ALL of the support into that region) -- repaired by splitting into two separate requirements P(C(T(D)))=1 and P(O(T(D))=Q(D))=1, or restricting to a validity domain X_Pi first; the submitted equivalence relation D1~D2 is repaired to be reflexive by restricting its domain to X_Pi; a proposed 'kernel' Sin ker(T_Pi) is judged premature (no ambient algebraic structure yet defined) and replaced by Null_Pi(T)/ZeroSet_{T,Pi}(D); an entropy lower bound is corrected from H(R*)>=H(Q(D))+H(C(D)|Q(D)) to the cleaner H(R*)>=H(Q(D)) once the contract's constraint vector is recognized as constant (H(C_R)=0) when required with probability 1; Kolmogorov complexity is separated out from Shannon entropy as a distinct later research track; the Minimal Adequate Representation is renamed Entropy-Minimal Adequate Representation to distinguish it from other minimality notions (description/dimension/cardinality/structural/computational); and the 5-digit-to-2-digit intuition is reformulated precisely as: R2 is zero-loss relative to (Q,Pi) iff Q(D)=O(R2), independent of digit count, giving the bridging research question 'can Vedic transformations discover minimal adequate representations?'

Establishes denominator discipline distinguishing source corpus size |N|=1395 from per-level usable empirical support N_n={i: R_{n,i}!=NULL} and completeness Comp_n=N_n/N (never silently normalized away, given the historical corpus already carries unreconciled denominators 1395/1496/1475); freezes the dataset contract D_REP=(D_i,Q_i,R5..R1,C1..5,O1..5) with seven rules (no synthetic intermediate states; Q_i established independently of R_n, never derived from it or from Zero-status, on pain of manufacturing H(Q|R_n)=0; missing representations explicit NULL/UNOBSERVED, never interpolated; every metric reports its actual denominator; completeness reported separately; historical k-classifications remain provenance fields, never newly inferred labels; no empirical result promoted to a population-level theorem); derives a closed-form fiber-violation formula N_viol=sum_r V_r with V_r=[(sum_q c_{r,q})^2 - sum_q c_{r,q}^2]/2 avoiding repeated counting; specifies a twelve-phase production audit (corpus discovery -> denominator reconciliation -> source schema discovery with a five-status vocabulary VERIFIED_OBSERVED/VERIFIED_DERIVED/PARTIAL/UNOBSERVED/AMBIGUOUS/CONTRADICTORY -> independent-Q audit rejecting Q derived from R_n or from Zero-status -> representation reconstruction audit explicitly warning that historical k=1/k=2/k=3/irreducible labels are provenance classifications, NOT automatically R1..R5 representation states -> transformation registry -> dataset construction -> completeness matrix -> level metrics -> canonical n* determination -> boundary diagnosis -> a mandatory 14-section final audit report); and specifies that empty-support entropy values must be recorded as None/undefined rather than 0.0, since zero entropy means a measured deterministic relationship while no observations means undefined.

A sequence of mathematical peer corrections converging on the frozen KR-REP-REDUCTION-2026-09 formal protocol. Fixes an indexing inconsistency to the clean chain R5=T5(D), R_{n-1}=T_n(R_n) for n=5..2, giving D->R5->R4->R3->R2->R1; replaces a too-strong requirement of strictly decreasing entropy H(R_n)<H(R_{n+1}) with strictly decreasing representation CAPACITY, keeping entropy an independently measured, non-monotone quantity; distinguishes empirical/observed adequacy (H_hat(Q|R_n)=0, a claim about the tested sample) from theoretical/population adequacy (H(Q|R_n)=0), adding the fiber-violation count N_viol(R_n) as an equivalent, more auditable structural diagnostic (N_viol=0 iff H_hat(Q|R)=0 on finite empirical support, though the two serve different diagnostic roles -- structural witness vs information summary); redefines the minimal adequate level not as argmin H(R_n) but as the boundary n*=min{n: A(R_n)=1, N_viol(R_n)=0, H_hat(Q|R_n)=0}, explicitly requiring the definition to name that R_{n*-1} actually fails and warning that if adequacy is non-monotone across the chain, the complete adequacy profile must be reported rather than a single boundary; measures both H(Q|R_n) (sufficiency) and H(R_n|Q) (renamed 'Q-relative residual representation,' never 'excess,' since residual distinctions such as provenance/uncertainty/lineage may be intentionally preserved by Pi even when Q-extraneous); derives the central decomposition identity H(T)=H(Q)+H(T|Q) for adequate deterministic T, hence H(T)>=H(Q) with equality iff H(T|Q)=0; corrects a proposed 'Q-isomorphic representation' (Level 4) to 'Q-equivalent representation' (mutual a.s. recoverability H(Q|T)=H(T|Q)=0), since factorization Q=O∘T alone does not establish a bijection; separates three independent boundary-failure diagnostic dimensions (Representation boundary: N_viol>0 or H(Q|R)>0; Contract boundary: A(R)<1; Operator boundary: H(Q|R)=0 but F(R)<1) explicitly allowed to co-occur rather than being mutually exclusive categories; and freezes the invariant Adequacy != Realization != Minimality != Q-equivalence together with the final measurement vector M_n=(A_n,F_n,H_hat(Q|R_n),H_hat(R_n|Q),H_hat(R_n),N_viol,n) as the canonical KR-REP-REDUCTION experimental protocol, explicitly deferring a controlled 2x2 (T_extreme/T_realistic x Pi_extreme/Pi_realistic) test of transformation-preservation interaction to a later stage.

A methodological pivot proposing that KR-ZERO-ORDER-2026-09's higher-order-Zero result be treated as mechanism-discovery evidence rather than a universal law, freezing as established: exists S such that individual Zero-status of every x in S does not imply Zero(S;D); Zero(x)&Zero(y) does not imply Zero({x,y}); and interaction order k is not globally monotone in |S|. Proposes a new experiment KR-ZERO-MECHANISM-2026-09 with three gates (denominator/accounting reconciliation across the historical 1395/1496/1475/1500 populations; complete witness extraction for the 115 irreducible cases; mechanism classification + minimal structural-dependency analysis per witness) before deciding the eventual carrier.
